marker_definitions.rare_universe: MAC>=2 and MAF<0.01 in FREQ, minor allele oriented from GT, with at least one minor copy in pooled REF_LAI.
marker_definitions.common_universe: MAF>=0.01 in FREQ, with both the FREQ-oriented minor allele and its complement observed in pooled REF_LAI.
marker_definitions.b0: Exactly 79791 common-universe sites, allocated by Hamilton across 0.05 cM bins and selected by fixed hash before any matching.
marker_definitions.br: B0 plus K rare sites selected by fixed hash within each bin before matching.
marker_definitions.bs: B0 plus K unique common-reserve controls selected by exact one-dimensional minimum-cost matching.

development.fraction_denominator: C=sum_b min(rare_b, common_reserve_b, B0_b); target K=floor(f*C); distribute exact K across bin capacities with Hamilton largest remainders.
development.selection_rule: Evaluate all four nested fractions only in seed 20260817 and freeze the largest fraction passing both geometry gates. Freeze its exact global K for validation.
development.rare_selection: Rank rare sites by fixed SHA-256 within bin and retain the bin quota before viewing common-marker distances.
development.matching_objective: Among common-reserve sites in the same bin, select the ordered unique subsequence minimizing sum(abs(rare_cm-control_cm)). Dynamic-programming ties retain the earlier candidate ordered by cM, bp and site_id.
development.null_rule: For each of 32 fixed hash replicates, select common pseudo-queries from B0 with the same per-bin K and run the identical exact matching algorithm against the common reserve.

validation.configuration: Run exactly once on seed 20260818 using width 0.05 cM, the frozen exact global K and the same salts, algorithms and 32 nulls.
validation.K_allocation: If validation total capacity is at least frozen K, distribute that exact K across validation bins by Hamilton using their preregistered capacity weights. Otherwise STOP_CAPACITY.

geometry_gate.p95: Observed rare-common p95 absolute delta cM must not exceed the maximum p95 among 32 common-common null replicates.
geometry_gate.wasserstein: Observed rare-common Wasserstein distance cM must not exceed the maximum among the same 32 common-common null replicates.

gates.V4_0_INPUT_IDENTITY: All shared, DEV and validation hashes match exactly.
gates.V4_1_ACCESS_BOUNDARY: Only FREQ and REF_LAI enter selection.
gates.V4_2_DEV_SELECTION: At least one frozen fraction passes both geometry gates in DEV.
gates.V4_3_B0_AND_PARITY: B0 is exactly 79791; BR and BS add the same K with identical bin quotas and no overlaps.
gates.V4_4_ANCESTRY_SCOPE: Selected rare sites retain nonzero AFR, EUR and ASIA support without relabelling ASIA as NAM.
gates.V4_5_VALIDATION_GEOMETRY: The single untouched validation passes both geometry gates with frozen K.
gates.V4_6_REPRODUCIBILITY: Two independent workflow executions are byte-identical for scientific outputs.
gates.V4_7_SCOPE: No LAI or truth metric is computed.

stop_rule: STOP BS without further iteration if no fraction passes DEV, validation capacity is below frozen K, validation fails either geometry metric, any forbidden pool is read, or reproducibility fails.
